examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo satt'āhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
atha kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū paṇītena sappipāyāsena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi. atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu.
santakāyo santavāco, santamano susamāhito, vantalok'āmiso bhikkhu, upasanto'ti vuccati.

58204.meaning1: with a calm mind; with a peaceful heart
58204.commentary: (ANa) santamānasā'ti mānasassa santatāya nibbutatāya paṇītatāya santamānasā. (UDa) santamānasan'ti chaṭṭhassa man'indriyassa nibbisevanabhāv'ūpagamanena vūpasantamānasaṃ.

examples.text: addasa bhagavantaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ sant'indriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttama-damatha-samatham'anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yat'indriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
tasmā't'iha, sāriputta, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, sant'indriyā bhavissāma santamānasā'ti. evañ'hi vo, sāriputta, sikkhitabbaṃ.
avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
s'āyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sneh'ānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī
tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

58209.meaning2: with the inner and the outer
58209.commentary: (DNa) santarabāhirā'ti saddhiṃ antopadesena c'eva bahipadesena ca sabbatthakam'eva udakasinehena phuṭā'ti attho.

examples.text: s'āyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sneh'ānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī

58210.meaning1: imprisoned inside and outside; held captive internally and externally
58210.meaningLit: bound with the bond inside and out

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano vedanābandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

58211.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of santarabāhira
58211.meaning1: internally and externally; within and without

examples.text: nagaraṃ yathā paccantaṃ, guttaṃ santarabāhiraṃ, evaṃ gopetha attānaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
kiṃ nu santaramāno'va, rāhu candaṃ pamuñcasi, saṃviggarūpo āgamma, kiṃ nu bhīto'va tiṭṭhasī'ti.

58214.meaning1: underrobe and upper robe; inner and outer robes

examples.text: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

58215.meaning1: an underrobe and upper robe at most; not more than an inner and outer robe
58215.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.7) santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabban'ti sace tīṇi naṭṭhāni honti dve sāditabbāni, dve naṭṭhāni ekaṃ sāditabbaṃ, ekaṃ naṭṭhaṃ na kiñci sāditabbaṃ.
58215.notes: Taken here as an adjective qualifying cīvara, it could also be taken as an adverb.

examples.text: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

58217.meaning1: is terrified (of); is frightened (of); is disturbed (by)

examples.text: sataṃ sahassāni'pi dhuttakānaṃ, idh'āgatā tādisakā bhaveyyuṃ, lomaṃ na iñjāmi na santasāmi, na māra bhāyāmi tam'ekikā'pi.
paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusal'ānuesī.

58220.meaning1: living with the virtuous; cohabiting with good people; (comm) living together of good people

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, santasannivāso hoti, kathañ'ca santo sannivasanti? idha, bhikkhave, therassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, thero'pi maṃ vadeyya, majjhimo'pi maṃ vadeyya, navo'pi maṃ vadeyya, therampāhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, majjhimam'p'āhaṃ vadeyyaṃ, navam'p'āhaṃ vadeyyaṃ.
santakāyo santavāco, santavā susamāhito, vantalok'āmiso bhikkhu, upasanto'ti vuccati.
santakāyo santavāco, santavā susamāhito, vantalok'āmiso bhikkhu, upasanto'ti vuccati.

58227.grammar: prp, masc acc sg of santa, trans (+acc)

examples.text: idha bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti
idañ'hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjatī'ti, santañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti vakkhatī'ti.
ehi tvaṃ, tāta uttara, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ'y'eva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā
santaṃ'y'eva pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti'ssa diṭṭhi hoti, s'āssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi. santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti saṅkappeti, sv'āssa hoti micchāsaṅkappo.
etādis'āyaṃ santāno, māy'āyaṃ bālalāpinī, vadhako esa akkhāto, sāro ettha na vijjati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye kassako mahānaṅgalena kasanto sabbāni mūlasantānakāni sampadālento kasati
kin't'āhaṃ kuṭikaṃ brūmi, kiṃ te brūmi kulāvakaṃ, kiṃ te santānakaṃ brūmi, kin't'āhaṃ brūmi bandhanan'ti.
mātaraṃ kuṭikaṃ brūsi, bhariyaṃ brūsi kulāvakaṃ, putte santānake brūsi, taṇhaṃ me brūsi bandhanan'ti.
so vat'āvuso, bhikkhu indriyesu aguttadvāro bhojane amattaññū jāgariyaṃ ananuyutto yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ santānessatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

58235.meaning1: to continue; to accomplish; to finish
58235.commentary: (ANa) na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretun'ti brahmacariyavāsaṃ anupacchijjamānaṃ gopetuṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu raj'aggaññ'eva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ. sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.
taṇh'ādhipanne manuje pekkhamāno, santāpajāte jarasā parete, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā'ti.
sabbasantāpānaṃ samitattā santo, sabb'ākusal'ābhisaṅkhārānaṃ santattā samitattā
taṇh'ādhipanne manuje pekkhamāno, santāpajāte jarasā parete, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.

58243.meaning1: heats up; burns away; dries up

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imāya ādittāya tiṇ'ukkāya gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ santāpessāmi saṃparitāpessāmī'ti.

58244.meaning1: to heat up; to burn away; to dry up

examples.text: gaṅgā hi, bhante, nadī gambhīrā appameyyā. sā na sukarā ādittāya tiṇ'ukkāya santāpetuṃ saṃparitāpetuṃ, yāva'd'eva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā'ti.

58248.meaning1: carrying across; ferrying to the other side
58248.commentary: (SNa) na c'assa nāvā santāraṇī'ti imāya nāvāya orimatīrato paratīraṃ gamissantī'ti evaṃ ṭhapitā ca santāraṇī nāvā na bhaveyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ… na c'assa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya.

58249.construction:
saṃ + tāre + aṇa + ī
santāraṇa + ī
58249.commentary: (SNa) na c'assa nāvā santāraṇī'ti imāya nāvāya orimatīrato paratīraṃ gamissantī'ti evaṃ ṭhapitā ca santāraṇī nāvā na bhaveyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ… na c'assa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya.
kiṃ me ekena tiṇṇena, purisena thāmadassinā, sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, santāressaṃ sadevakaṃ.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, n'atthi yo maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassā'ti.
ye'pi dīgh'āyukā devā, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, bhītā santāsam'āpāduṃ, sīhass'ev'itare migā.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, n'atthi yo maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse māluvāsipāṭikā phaleyya. atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, māluvābījaṃ aññatarasmiṃ sālamūle nipateyya. atha kho, bhikkhave, yā tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthā devatā sā bhītā saṃviggā santāsaṃ āpajjeyya.

58256.meaning1: there are friend; there are brother

examples.text: sant'āvuso, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sant'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti. santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, daḷhaṃ sikkhatha santiyā, mā vo pamatte viññāya, maccurājā amohayittha vas'ānuge.
etañ'ca dhammam'aññāya, vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe, santī'ti nibbutiṃ ñatvā, sāsane gotamassa na pamajjeyya.

58259.meaning1: they are; there are; they exist

examples.text: ko'dha santusito loke, kassa no santi iñjitā, ko ubh'antam'abhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati, kaṃ brūsi mahāpuriso'ti, ko idha sibbinim'accagā.
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ
yāya mātu bhato poso, imaṃ lokaṃ avekkhati, tam'pi pāṇadadiṃ santiṃ, hanti kuddho puthujjano.
santi idh'ekacce khattiyā, brāhmaṇā'ti bhaṇati
so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ, dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cā'ti, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
ehi nandaka gacchāma, upajjhāyassa santikaṃ, sīhanādaṃ nadissāma, buddhaseṭṭhassa sammukhā.
tasmiṃ samaye catusattatisahassajaṭilā paṇītapaṇītāni ojavantāni phal'āphalāni gahetvā ācariyassa santikaṃ sampattā buddhānañ'c'eva ācariyassa ca nisinnāsanaṃ oloketvā āhaṃsu.

58263.commentary: (THa) n'āhāro hadayassa santiko'ti āhāro ca āhariyamāno maggaphalañāṇaṃ viya hadayassa cittassa santikaro na hoti, kevalaṃ pana sajjukaṃ khudāpaṭighātamattaṃ karotī'ti adhippāyo.
58263.notes: see Norman EV note 123 'nāhāro hṛdayasya śāntaye'

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ anayena jīvitaṃ, n'āhāro hadayassa santiko, āhāraṭṭhitiko samussayo, iti disvāna carāmi esanaṃ.

58264.meaning1: (comm) appeasement of deities upon fulfilling a request
58264.commentary: (DNa) santikamman'ti devaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā sace me idaṃ nāma samijjhissati, tumhākaṃ iminā ca iminā ca upahāraṃ karissāmī'ti samiddhikāle kattabbaṃ santipaṭissavakammaṃ. tasmiṃ pana samiddhe tassa karaṇaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ nāma.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ

58266.grammar: ind, prep, acc sg of santika (+gen)
58266.meaning1: into the presence (of); towards; near (to); close (to)
58266.construction:
sa + anta + ika + aṃ
santika + aṃ

examples.text: eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.
bhisamuḷālaṃ gaṇhitvā, agamaṃ buddhasantikaṃ, tañ'ca buddhassa pādāsiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

58267.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of santika (+gen)

examples.text: āgatā kho mayaṃ mārisa amha tassa bhagavato santikā arahato sammāsambuddhassa

sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.

58268.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of santika (+gen)

examples.text: āyām'āvuso bhāradvāja, yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamissāma, app'eva nāma labheyyāma bhagavato santikā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.

58269.commentary: (DNa) upaṭṭhāko santik'āvacaro'ti upaṭṭhāko hutvā santik'āvacaro, na randhagavesī. na vīmaṃsan'ādhippāyo.

examples.text: etu kho āyasmā ānando! svāgataṃ āyasmato ānandassa bhagavato upaṭṭhākassa bhagavato santik'āvacarassa!

58271.grammar: ind, prep, loc sg of santika (+gen or +dat)
58271.meaning1: to; in the presence (of); near (to); nearby; close (to); on the verge (of)
58271.synonym: abhito, upanissāya, nissāya, santikaṃ, samīpaṃ, samīpe, sāmantā

examples.text: satañ'ca vivaṭaṃ hoti, āloko passatām'iva, santike na vijānanti, magā dhammass'akovidā.
n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.

58272.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of santika (+gen)

examples.text: kusaggen'udakam'ādāya, samudde udakaṃ mine, evaṃ mānusakā kāmā, dibbakāmāna santike.

58273.meaning1: remains still; stands still; settles down
58273.meaning2: stands still, remains, is fixed or settled

examples.text: tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.

so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. so hoti samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.

58274.commentary: (MNa) santiṭṭhatī'ti patiṭṭhāti. manussānañ'hi mahantaṃ paṭaparissāvanamattañ'ca udarapaṭalaṃ nāma hoti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati, yattha ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ santiṭṭhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgaṃ nikkhamati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tassa purisassa amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'ūpāyāsā'ti?
puriso nāma manussapuriso na yakkho na peto na tiracchānagato viññū paṭibalo santiṭṭhituṃ sallapituṃ.
addasa bhagavantaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ sant'indriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttama-damatha-samatham'anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yat'indriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
santussako ca subharo ca, appakicco ca sallahukavutti, sant'indriyo ca nipako ca, appagabbho kulesu ananugiddho.

58278.meaning1: state of peace; tranquillity; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: tayo vitakke kusale vitakkaye, tayo pana akusale nirākare, sa ve vitakkāni vicāritāni, sameti vuṭṭhī'va rajaṃ samūhataṃ, sa ve vitakk'ūpasamena cetasā, idh'eva so santipadaṃ samajjhagā'ti.
sutvān'ahaṃ vīram'akāmakāmiṃ, ogh'ātigaṃ puṭṭhum'akāmam'āgamaṃ, santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

58279.meaning1: higher than tranquillity; greater than peace
58279.commentary: (DHPa) santiparan'ti nibbānato uttariṃ aññaṃ sukham'pi n'atthi. aññañ'hi sukhaṃ sukham'eva, nibbānaṃ paramasukhan'ti attho.

examples.text: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhasamā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.
upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, lok'āmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho'ti.

58281.meaning1: path to peace; road to tranquillity

examples.text: ucchinda sineham'attano, kumudaṃ sāradikaṃ'va, santimaggam'eva brūhaya, nibbānaṃ sugatena desitaṃ.

58282.meaning1: highest peace; supreme tranquillity; total calm
58282.commentary: (NIDD2) santim'uttaman'ti santi vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. uttaman'ti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ viseṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaran'ti, mahesi santim'uttamaṃ. (THIa) aphusiṃ santim'uttaman'ti anuttaraṃ santiṃ nibbānaṃ phusiṃ adhigacchin'ti attho.

examples.text: tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi, mahesi santim'uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
so'haṃ padhānapahit'atto, rattin'divam'atandito, mātarā codito santo, aphusiṃ santim'uttamaṃ.

58283.meaning1: sublime state of peace; epithet of Nibbāna
58283.commentary: (MN) anuttaraṃ santivarapadan'ti uttamaṃ santisaṅkhātaṃ varapadaṃ, nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno'ti attho.

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃ

58284.meaning1: promoting a doctrine of peace; professing peace

examples.text: yehi vivitto vicareyya loke, na tāni uggayha vadeyya nāgo, jal'ambujaṃ kaṇḍakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā, jalena paṅkena c'anūpalittaṃ, evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho, kāme ca loke ca anūpalitto.

58285.grammar: prp, fem nom sg of santa, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: sikkhamānā ahaṃ santī, bhāventī maggam'añjasaṃ, pahāsiṃ rāgadosañ'ca, tadekaṭṭhe ca āsave.
na santi kāmā manujesu niccā, sant'īdha kamanīyāni yesu baddho, yesu pamatto apun'āgamanaṃ, anāgantā puriso maccudheyyā'ti.
diṭṭhamattaṃ nāma tatth'eva uppannaṃ sampaṭicchanasantīraṇavoṭṭhabbanasaṅkhātaṃ cittattayaṃ.

58288.synonym: abhiraddha, patīta, santappita, santusita, santussita, tappita, titta, tuṭṭha, āraddha
58288.commentary: (SNa) santuṭṭho'ti catūsu paccayesu yathālābhasantoso yathābalasantoso yathāsāruppasantoso'ti, imehi tīhi santosehi samannāgato.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, santuṭṭhā bhavissāma itar'ītarena cīvarena, itar'ītara-cīvara-santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādino, na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjissāma.
santuṭṭhassa-ayaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa

58289.meaning2: name of a lay disciple; lit. satisfied

examples.text: santuṭṭho nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

58292.commentary: (DHPa) santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanan'ti gihino vā pabbajitassa vā yaṃ attanā laddhaṃ attano santakaṃ, ten'eva tussanabhāvo santuṭṭhī nāma sesadhanehi paramaṃ dhanaṃ.

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
tañ'hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ app'icchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattissati

58293.meaning1: talk about satisfaction; discussion about contentment

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā, attanā ca santuṭṭho santuṭṭhikathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.
acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, tathāgatassa app'icchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā. yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃ mah'iddhiko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo.

58297.synonym: abhiraddha, āraddha, tappita, tuṭṭha, patīta, santappita, santuṭṭha

examples.text: hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.
ko'dha santusito loke, kassa no santi iñjitā, ko ubh'antam'abhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati, kaṃ brūsi mahāpuriso'ti, ko idha sibbinim'accagā.

58298.meaning1: name of a deity; lord of Tusita heaven
58298.meaning2: name of a deity; lord of Tusita heaven

examples.text: atha kho santusito devaputto…

58299.meaning1: fact of satisfaction; state of contentment

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
